name: Pattern BLOCKCHAIN: Integer Accounting
description: Contract balances are updated through multiple arithmetic operations.

name: Pattern BLOCKCHAIN: Solidity Access Control
description: A smart contract exposes privileged functions whose authorization logic may be flawed.

name: Pattern BLOCKCHAIN: Reentrancy Classic
description: Withdraw pattern allows reentrant drain.

name: Pattern CRYPTO: Classical Caesar
description: Caesar or simple substitution on English text.

name: Pattern CRYPTO: Base Encoding Layers
description: A text artifact is wrapped in one or more reversible encodings.

name: Pattern CRYPTO: Classical Substitution
description: Letter patterns are transformed consistently by a substitution rule.

name: Pattern CRYPTO: Single-byte XOR
description: A byte string was XORed with one unknown repeated byte.

name: Pattern CRYPTO: Weak RSA Parameters
description: An RSA challenge exposes public parameters with a suspicious mathematical relationship.

name: Pattern CRYPTO: XOR Single Byte
description: Ciphertext XORed with one repeating key byte. Recover plaintext.

name: Pattern FORENSICS: EXIF GPS
description: Image GPS EXIF used for geolocation.

name: Pattern FORENSICS: File Carving
description: A disk image may contain deleted or embedded files.

name: Pattern FORENSICS: Image Metadata
description: An image may contain capture or editing metadata not visible in pixels.

name: Pattern FORENSICS: LSB Stego
description: PNG hides flag in least significant bits.

name: Pattern FORENSICS: PCAP HTTP
description: A packet capture contains application traffic that may reconstruct a sequence of requests.

name: Pattern FORENSICS: PNG Steganography
description: A PNG may encode information in pixel channels rather than visible image content.

name: Pattern MISC: Encoding Recognition
description: An unfamiliar blob may be text, encoded bytes, or a compressed container.

name: Pattern MISC: Layered Encoding
description: Flag wrapped in base64 then hex repeatedly.

name: Pattern MISC: Nested Archive
description: A challenge file contains one or more nested containers.

name: Pattern MISC: Multilayer Encoding
description: Flag through multiple encoding layers.

name: Pattern MOBILE: Android Manifest Review
description: An Android package may expose components through its manifest configuration.

name: Pattern MOBILE: Hardcoded Secret Discovery
description: A mobile application bundle contains constants that may be sensitive configuration.

name: Pattern OSINT: Domain DNS Pivot
description: A challenge provides a domain and expects public infrastructure clues.

name: Pattern OSINT: EXIF Geolocation
description: A public image may retain location metadata.

name: Pattern OSINT: Username Correlation
description: A handle appears across publicly accessible challenge clues.

name: Pattern PWN: Format String
description: User input is used as a printf-style format string.

name: Pattern PWN: Return-to-libc
description: A memory-corruption bug exists but injected code execution is restricted.

name: Pattern PWN: Stack Overflow
description: A program copies more attacker-controlled bytes into a fixed stack buffer than it can hold.

name: Pattern PWN: Ret2win
description: Stack overflow; win() exists; overwrite return address.

name: Pattern REV: Anti Debug
description: Binary exits under debugger via ptrace-style checks.

name: Pattern REV: Packed Binary
description: A binary has little useful static content and appears to unpack code at runtime.

name: Pattern REV: Simple Crackme
description: A local binary compares user input against hidden conditions.

name: Pattern REV: XOR Obfuscation
description: Embedded data is transformed with a repeating XOR operation before comparison.

name: Pattern WEB: Path Traversal
description: File download endpoint concatenates user path without normalization.

name: Pattern WEB: SSTI Jinja
description: User-controlled template expression reaches Jinja renderer.

name: Pattern WEB: JWT Validation
description: A service authorizes requests using JSON Web Tokens.

name: Pattern WEB: Path Traversal
description: A file-serving feature derives a filesystem path from user input.

name: Pattern WEB: Server-Side Template Injection
description: User-controlled content is rendered by a server-side template engine.

name: Pattern WEB: SQL Injection
description: An application appears to construct database queries from request-controlled values.

name: Pattern WEB: SSTI Jinja
description: Flask app renders unsanitized user input in Jinja2. Recover secret config via SSTI.

name: Pattern WEB: UNION SQLi
description: PHP search vulnerable to UNION-based SQL injection.

name: PwnCTF2024 - PrintfLeak
description: A binary passes user-controlled input directly as the format argument to printf() instead of using a fixed format string with the input as a data argument, e.g. printf(user_input) instead of printf("%s", user_input).

name: PwnCTF2024 - ClassicStack
description: A statically-linked-looking x86_64 binary reads a name into a fixed-size stack buffer with gets(), no canary, NX enabled, no PIE. libc version is provided alongside the binary.

name: RevCTF2024 - LicenseCheck
description: A statically-linked Linux binary asks for a license key on stdin and prints 'Access granted' or 'Access denied'. No obvious anti-debug tricks.

name: WebCTF2024 - AuthBreaker
description: A login portal issues JWTs signed with RS256. The admin panel trusts the role claim in the token.

name: WebCTF2024 - LoginBypass
description: A login form builds a SQL query by directly concatenating the username and password fields into a WHERE clause, with no parameterization.
